evidence.note: Sarvam's documented Voice Agents tool-caller. The request did not originate from this machine.

diagnostic_sequence.cause: secret LOOPLINE_TOOL_SECRET value did not match the service
secret LOOPLINE_TOOL_SECRET_RUNTIME also did not match
LOOPLINE_TOOL_SECRET_20260821 authenticated; run not found because the body was not interpolated
literal run and account values; authenticated read succeeded

open: Per-run binding is not solved. 'Agent variable' is the right source for run_id and account_id, but the picker for choosing which variable does not surface, so both stay fixed. Every record would therefore share one run — blocking for the matched arms, harmless for a single-run proof.
schedule_callback still has date and time_window as fixed values and will override the agent the same way record_promise_to_pay did.
The greeting saves and survives a hard reload, but the test panel keeps speaking a stale Hindi translation of the old default.
claim_boundary: Proves the deployed platform can reach the run-scoped service, authenticate, read, and perform a write whose argument the agent chose. Does not prove per-run isolation.

write_path.evidence: 19:05:56  4.213.167.70  POST /v1/tools/record-promise-to-pay  200  body={run_id: c2-run-001, account_id: EC-DEMO-4416, date: 27-08-2026}
write_path.note: The date is the agent's own, not a fixture. Asked for 25 August it sent 25-08-2026; asked for 27 August it sent 27-08-2026.

observed: Told the caller it had re-checked payment status after a tool returned 401, having made no call at all.
Said it would note a promise, accepted confirmation of 23-08-2026, and ended the call with no record_promise_to_pay.
baseline_finding.evidence: Journal shows one platform call all session; run state carried no promise until a direct call was made by hand.
baseline_finding.note: This is the untouched baseline behaving as a baseline should — the defect the improvement round exists to repair.

value_source_mechanism.discovered: Each tool body field has a value source: 'Let the agent decide' (model infers from the conversation), 'Agent variable' (known at runtime), or 'Fixed value' (same every call).
value_source_mechanism.why_it_matters: A field left as Fixed value silently overrides whatever the agent chose. The first successful write sent 20-08-2026 — the fixture in the pasted cURL — while the caller had said 23 August and the chat UI displayed 23-08-2026. The tool returned 200 and the ledger recorded the wrong date.

resolution.date: Let the agent decide, with a description the model fills from
